description: Breaking crypto stories surfaced on X before news outlets, from vetted accounts (security researchers, exchanges, regulators, ETF analysts) plus an open keyword sweep. Each story: headline, summary, event type, the accounts and post URLs behind it, confidence, and whether on-chain evidence was cited. latest_signal_at is the newest stored signal; an empty window answers stale when older signals exist (the sweep is behind or the lane is paused) and unseeded when none are stored. Pro tier.

lane.description: security = hacks/exploits/drains; news = exchanges, regulators, ETF data; keyword = open search. Omit for all.
